sources.tracer_color_rgba: Tracer line colour and opacity (0-255 each).
sources.tracer_width_px: Tracer line width in pixels of one view tile.
sources.fade_after_s: Seconds of flight after which the older part of the tracer is no longer drawn; null keeps the whole trace to the end of the clip.
sources.ball_color_rgb: Colour of the ball in flight (the ball on the tee is the scene's own ball).
sources.min_ball_radius_px: Smallest drawn ball radius, so a distant ball stays visible; a nearer ball is drawn at its projected size.
sources.fov_y_deg: Vertical field of view of the viewer camera the overlay is projected through. 45 is the MuJoCo free-camera default the native export uses; another viewer needs its own value or the overlay will not line up.
sources.near_clip_m: Points closer to the camera plane than this are not drawn.
sources.landing_hold_s: Seconds the clip continues after the ball lands.
sources.max_hold_s: Upper bound on the swing time added after the last pose to show the flight.
sources.draw_invalid_flight: false: a flight the model flags as outside its validity envelope is not drawn and the reason is shown. true: it is drawn and labelled as outside the envelope (for inspection only).
sources.occlude_by_scene: true: the golfer and club hide the tracer and ball where nearer to the camera (needs the renderer's depth image; without it the overlay is drawn over everything and a warning is logged); false: always over everything.
sources.occlusion_tolerance_m: Metres by which the scene may be nearer than a tracer point before it hides it (depth noise; the tracer starts on the tee).
sources.occlusion_tolerance_fraction: Extra tolerance as a fraction of the point's distance (depth precision falls with distance).
sources.occlusion_step_px: Tracer segments are split into pieces of at most this many pixels for the depth test.
sources.landing_marker: Object (null turns the marker off): when (at_landing or from_start); ground_z_m ground height; radius_m ring radius; min_radius_px and min_aspect keep the ring readable at distance (a marker size, not the landing area); the scene never hides the ring; color_rgba, line_width_px. Aids (each off by default in code, on here): ground_track draws the flight path projected onto the ground (ground_track_color_rgba, ground_track_width_px), revealed with the tracer; drop_line draws a vertical line from the ball to the ground while in flight; occlude_track lets the scene hide both (the far ground is too coarse in the depth image, so off here); carry_label writes the carry the flight model reports under the ring once landed, as carry_label_format ({carry} = carry times carry_label_scale, {unit} = carry_label_unit, e.g. yd with scale 1.0936), in carry_label_size_px with an outline of carry_label_outline_px, carry_label_gap_px beneath the ring.
